verdict.rationale: Loops offers a Content API (LMX) for authoring campaign templates programmatically with variable substitution, and syncs with the visual editor, plus underlying editor is built on extended MJML per founder comments. However, there's no evidence of exporting/importing templates as version-controllable HTML/MJML files, no git-based workflow, and no documented file-based template storage — templates live in the Loops platform/database rather than as code artifacts in a repo. missing for 10: version-control/git workflow support, HTML/MJML file export-import capability, documented local file-based template storage, independent confirmation of MJML template editing via API.
